bias.zh: 反弹 · 冲高 $300 上方回落，守住 $293–296

read.en: Alphabet fell 1.0% on Nov 13 to $295.77, trading $293.44–304.97. It is above the rising 5-day ($292.7) and the 10-day ($287.9) and below the 30-day ($318.6), 100-day ($338.4) and 200-day ($338.5), all falling. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($279.04), and RSI is 40.6.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月13日下跌 1.0%，收于 $295.77，盘中区间 $293.44–304.97。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$292.7）和 10 日均线（$287.9）上方，位于 30 日（$318.6）、100 日（$338.4）和 200 日均线（$338.5）下方，三者均在下行。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$279.04），RSI 为 40.6。

read.en: The $304.97 high cleared $300–302.6 intraday, but the close fell back to the $293.4–296.5 support, which held. Resistance is $300–305 (round number, Nov 12–13 highs), then $314.9 (Jul 23 low) and $318.6 (30-day). Support is $293.4–296.5, then $289.5–292.7 (5-day, Nov 11 low) and $285.7–287.9 (10-day, Nov 10 low). A close above $305 would target $315; below $293.4, $289.5–292.7.

r.en: $300 round number; Nov 12 high $302.56; Nov 13 high $304.97
